tests.name: json_view_editable_nan_self_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether a NaN written into an editable json_view document compares equal to itself.

tests.name: json_view_editable_nan_equality_to_other
tests.intent: Probes equality between two different views of editable documents both containing NaN.

tests.name: json_view_unedited_self_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether an unedited editable json_view document root correctly considers itself equal to itself via the fast path.

tests.name: json_view_readonly_nan_check
tests.intent: Probes comparison behavior on read-only json_view documents since they cannot contain edited NaN values.

tests.name: json_view_editable_infinity_self_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether positive and negative infinities written by edits still compare equal to themselves.

tests.name: json_view_compare_with_basic_json_nan
tests.intent: Probes comparing an edited view containing NaN against a standard nlohmann::json object holding NaN.

tests.name: json_view_nested_array_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether an array containing an edited NaN propagates inequality when comparing the parent container.

tests.name: json_view_object_field_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether an object containing a field set to NaN compares equal to itself.

tests.name: json_view_push_back_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes equality when a NaN is pushed into an editable json_view array.

tests.name: json_view_insert_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes equality when a NaN is inserted into an editable json_view container.

tests.name: json_view_mixed_nan_and_normal_floats
tests.intent: Probes equality of an array containing both normal floats and an edited NaN value.

tests.name: json_view_editable_view_compare_mismatched_nan
tests.intent: Probes comparing two editable views where one has a normal float and the other has a NaN at the same spot.

tests.name: json_view_multiple_edits_walk_check
tests.intent: Probes equality traversal on an editable document with multiple non-NaN edits to ensure fallback walk correctness.

tests.name: json_view_editable_nan_cross_document_equality
tests.intent: Probes comparison between root nodes of two distinct editable documents independently assigned NaN.

tests.name: json_view_editable_nan_in_nested_object
tests.intent: Probes deep nested structure containing an edited NaN for self-equality behavior.

tests.name: json_view_editable_nan_converted_to_json
tests.intent: Probes conversion of an editable view with an edited NaN into a standard json object.

tests.name: json_view_editable_negative_zero_equality
tests.intent: Probes equality handling of negative zeros written as edits in editable json_view documents.

tests.name: json_view_editable_nan_compared_to_null
tests.intent: Probes equality comparison between an edited NaN view and a null value in an editable document.

tests.name: json_view_editable_multiple_nan_array
tests.intent: Probes an array filled with multiple edited NaN values and checks self-equality.

tests.name: json_view_editable_nan_dump_output
tests.intent: Probes string dumping behavior of an editable json_view document containing an edited NaN value.
